meta.name: thalassa_polis
meta.prompt: A modern Hellenist city being invaded by sea monsters.

character.label: modern Hellenist city under maritime siege

programs.brief: A colossal eldritch sea monster rising out of the foaming bay, multiple spiked tentacles curling upwards around a massive maw with glowing prismarine eyes, assaulting the city's seawall.
A towering modern-classical quartz colossus of Athena with an elevated gilded spear standing upon a marble bastion overlooking the ocean, defiantly facing the sea beast.
An armored sea serpent or tentacled aquatic horror breaching the ocean surface, coiled toward the shoreline with jagged fins and dark scales.

tokens.terrain: a modern coastal metropolis with a harbour, promenade, and deep open sea
tokens.event_direction: giant sea monsters emerging from the open sea attacking the waterfront and port
tokens.infra: barricade_line along the seafront promenade; emergency barricades across the coastal boulevards leading to the harbor
tokens.icons: monumental neoclassical stoas and government colonnades alongside modern high-rises; sea monsters breaching the harbor breakwater
